purpose: Compare depth/geometry representation options and their limitations

current_representation.name: VGGT_518x518_MESH
defects: DEPTH_EDGE_BLEED: avg 352.97 px offset from RGB edges
MESH_DENSITY_LIMIT: 500 pano-px per triangle is extremely coarse
25% triangle rejection at depth discontinuities leaves cracks
89.4% of RGB structural edges have no corresponding depth edge
Depth map at 518x518 cannot represent sub-8px scene structure

candidate_improvements.name: BASELINE_R4P4
candidate_improvements.description: Current R4P4 output — baseline for comparison

candidate_improvements.name: 2X_MESH_DENSITY
candidate_improvements.description: Same depth, bilinear-upsampled to 1036x1036 grid — denser triangulation
candidate_improvements.expected_improvement: Reduces pano-px/triangle from 500 to 125 — may reduce polygon banding
candidate_improvements.expected_limitation: Depth edge bleed does not improve — zigzag boundary unchanged

candidate_improvements.name: EDGE_AWARE_UPSAMPLE_2X
candidate_improvements.description: Guided-filter upsampled depth (using RGB as guidance) at 1036x1036
candidate_improvements.expected_improvement: Depth edges align better with RGB edges — reduces edge bleed
candidate_improvements.expected_limitation: Guided filter can hallucinate depth at complex boundaries

candidate_improvements.name: CONFIDENCE_GATED_1X
candidate_improvements.description: Mask low-confidence depth (high gradient regions) — hole-fill from neighbors
candidate_improvements.expected_improvement: Reduces jagged artifacts at depth discontinuities
candidate_improvements.expected_limitation: May increase visible cracks near sharp boundaries

candidate_improvements.name: EDGE_AWARE_UPSAMPLE_2X_GATED
candidate_improvements.description: Combination of C (guided upsample) + D (confidence gating)
candidate_improvements.expected_improvement: Best candidate for reducing both edge bleed and jagged artifacts
candidate_improvements.expected_limitation: Highest computational cost — Modal render required

render_constraint: DO NOT use existing R4P4 rasterizer on local machine — requires Modal L40S
